contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Talk to HomeLoop on WhatsApp, phone or email about an order, selling an item, or installation. We serve customers across the UAE.

contact.a1: Cash on delivery or on collection. No card needed.
contact.q2: Do you deliver to my emirate?
contact.a2: We deliver across the UAE. The fee depends on your city and is shown before you order.
contact.a3: Yes. Add installation or assembly when you order; the price is shown in the order form.
contact.a4: If an item doesn't match its description, you can refuse it at the door, or tell us on WhatsApp within {hours} hours of delivery. We collect it free and refund you in full, including delivery and service fees.
contact.q5: Can I collect my order myself?
contact.a5: Yes. Choose pickup in the order form and collect it from our warehouse during working hours, with no delivery fee.

guide.heading: Home, villa and office moves across the UAE
guide.body: We move apartments, villas and offices within Dubai and between all emirates, from a single room to a full office. Our team handles loading, transport and unloading, and can pack, dismantle and reassemble your furniture when you add those services.

guide.heading: What affects your moving quote
guide.body: The price depends on how much there is to move, the floor and access at both addresses, the distance between them, and the extra services you choose. That's why every move starts with a free site visit: you get one clear quote before you book, with no obligation.

guide.heading: Plumbers, electricians and AC technicians in Dubai
guide.body: From leaking taps and blocked drains to faulty sockets and AC problems, our technicians visit homes and offices in Dubai and across the UAE. Choose the service you need below and tell us what's wrong.

guide.heading: How a technician visit works
guide.body: Send your request with a short description, your area and a time that suits you, and add photos if you can. Mark it urgent if it can't wait. We call you to confirm the visit and the price before the technician comes.
